name: Logo Symbolism + Brand-System Discipline
source: HMC Logo critique PDF, HMC batch-1 distillation 2026-10-06

symbolism.center_crystal: the essence: soul, divine spark, awakened self - the hidden thing now revealed
symbolism.circular_structure: protection, order, cosmic intelligence - the system behind the system
symbolism.crown: sovereignty, rightful inheritance, mastery - remember who you are
symbolism.typography: elevated, ceremonial - a title carved into history
symbolism.wings_side_figures: guardian energy; protectors of wisdom; balance

system_rule: The master logo is ONE of a system, never a single asset. The full mark being too detailed for tiny placements is system thinking, not a weakness.
